snp3.7:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Aṅguttarāpesu cārikañ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi yena Āpaṇaṃ nāma Aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo etad avasari.
snp3.7:1.4: "samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi Āpaṇaṃ anuppatto,
snp3.7:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato,
snp3.7:1.6: iti pi: so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā,
snp3.7:1.7: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti,
snp3.7:1.8: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ, kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti:
snp3.7:1.9: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī" ti.
snp3.7:2.1: Atha kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
snp3.7:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:2.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ Bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
snp3.7:2.4: Atha kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
snp3.7:2.5: "adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā" ti.
snp3.7:2.6: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
snp3.7:2.7: "mahā kho Keṇiya bhikkhusaṃgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, tvañ ca kho brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno" ti.
snp3.7:3.1: Dutiyam pi kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
snp3.7:3.2: "kiñcāpi bho Gotama mahā bhikkhusaṃgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni ahañ ca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno,
snp3.7:3.3: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā" ti.
snp3.7:3.4: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā Keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
snp3.7:3.5: "mahā kho Keṇiya bhikkhusaṃgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, tvañ ca kho brāh maṇesu abhippasanno" ti.
snp3.7:4.1: Tatiyam pi kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
snp3.7:4.2: "kiñcāpi bho Gotama mahā bhikkhusaṃgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni ahañ ca kho brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno,
snp3.7:4.3: adhivāsetv-eva me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā" ti.
snp3.7:4.5: Atha kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena sako assamo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā mittāmacce ñātisālohite āmantesi:
snp3.7:4.7: samaṇo me Gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena,
snp3.7:4.9: "Evaṃ bho" ti kho Keṇiyassa jaṭilassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā Keṇiyassa jaṭilassa paṭissutvā app-ekacce uddhanāni khaṇanti, app-ekacce kaṭṭhāni phāḷenti, appekacce bhājanāni dhovanti, app-ekacce udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpenti, app-ekacce āsanāni paññāpenti,
snp3.7:4.10: Keṇiyo pana jaṭilo sāmaṃ yeva maṇḍalamāḷaṃ paṭiyādeti.
snp3.7:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena Selo brāhmaṇo Āpaṇe paṭivasati tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo, tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti.
snp3.7:6.1: Tena kho pana samayena Keṇiyo jaṭilo Sele brāhmaṇe abhippasanno hoti.
snp3.7:6.2: Atha kho Selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi parivuto jaṃghāvihāraṃ anucaṃkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena Keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo ten' upasaṃkami.
snp3.7:6.3: Addasā kho Selo brāhmaṇo Keṇiyassamiye jaṭile app-ekacce uddhanāni khaṇante --pe-- app-ekacce āsanāni paññāpente, Keṇiyaṃ pana jaṭilaṃ sāmañ ñeva maṇḍalamāḷaṃ paṭiyādentaṃ,
snp3.7:6.5: "ki nu bhoto Keṇiyassa āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā bhavissati, mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito, rājā vā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenā" ti.
snp3.7:7.1: "Na me Sela āvāho bhavissati, na pi vivāho bhavissati, na pi rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyena,
snp3.7:7.2: api ca kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito
snp3.7:7.3: atthi: samaṇo Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḍasehi bhikkhusatehi Āpaṇaṃ anuppatto.
snp3.7:7.6: so me nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā" ti.
snp3.7:8.1: Atha bho Selassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
snp3.7:8.2: ‘ghoso pi kho eso dullabho lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ ‘Buddho' ti.
snp3.7:8.3: Āgatāni kho pana asmākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dve va gatiyo bhavanti anaññā:
snp3.7:8.4: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato,
snp3.7:8.5: tass' imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyathīdaṃ:
snp3.7:8.6: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanam eva sattamaṃ,
snp3.7:8.7: parosahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā,
snp3.7:8.8: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
snp3.7:8.9: Sace kho panāgārasmā anagāriyāṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchaddo --
snp3.7:8.10: "kahaṃ pana bho Keṇiya etarahi so bhavaṃ Gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho" ti.
snp3.7:9.1: Evaṃ vutte Keṇiyo jaṭilo dakkhiṇaṃ bāhaṃ paggahetvā Selaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:
snp3.7:9.3: Atha kho Selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami.
snp3.7:9.4: Atha kho Selo brāhmaṇo te māṇavake āmantesi:
snp3.7:9.6: durāsadā hi te bhagavanto sīhā va ekacarā,
snp3.7:9.7: yadā cāhaṃ bho samaṇena Gotamena saddhiṃ manteyyaṃ, mā me bhonto antarantarā kathaṃ opātetha,
snp3.7:10.1: Atha kho Selo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
snp3.7:10.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:10.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Selo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi.
snp3.7:10.4: Addasā kho Selo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve,
snp3.7:10.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṃkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati:
snp3.7:11.2: ‘passati kho me ayaṃ Selo brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve,
snp3.7:11.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṃkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati:
snp3.7:11.4: kosohite ca vatthaguyhe pahūtajivhatāya cā' ti.
snp3.7:11.5: Atha kho Bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkhāsi, yathā x addasa Selo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
snp3.7:11.6: Atha kho Bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubho pi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalam pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
snp3.7:12.1: Atha kho Selassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
snp3.7:12.2: ‘sammannāgato kho samaṇo Gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehi,
snp3.7:12.3: no ca kho naṃ jānāmi ‘Buddho vā no vā.'
snp3.7:12.4: Sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
snp3.7:12.5: "ye te bhavanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā, te sake vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attānaṃ pātukarontī" ti,
snp3.7:12.6: yan nūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyan 'ti.
snp3.7:12.7: Atha kho Selo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi: 548.
snp3.7:33.1: Alattha kho Selo brāhmaṇo sapariso Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
snp3.7:33.2: Atha kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena sake assame paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
snp3.7:33.4: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
snp3.7:34.1: Atha kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo Buddha-pamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
snp3.7:34.2: Atha kho Keṇiyo jaṭilo Bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:34.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ Bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi: 568.
snp3.7:37.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
snp3.7:37.2: Atha kho āyasmā Selo sapariso eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirass' eva, *yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi, ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññāsi.
snp3.7:37.3: *Aññataro ca kho panāyasmā Selo sapariso arahataṃ ahosi.
snp3.7:38.1: Atha kho āyasmā Selo sapariso yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi: 570.
snp3.7:42.4: nāgā vandantu Satthuno" ti SELASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ. 574. Animittam anaññātaṃ
